# Technical viewer samples

`cube.stp` and `cube.igs` are the simple-basic-cube and cube-10x10mm fixtures from [occt-import-js](https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js/tree/main/test/testfiles), used to verify real OpenCascade conversion. See upstream licensing in `docs/licenses/occt-import-js-LICENSE.md`.

Other tiny models/drawings are generated in the browser test. Owner enclosure STEP files are used only from the private acceptance scratch directory and are not committed.
